meaning:
προ-τρέχω
[in LXX: 1Ki.8:11 (פָּנִים רוּץ), Job.41:13 (14) A (דּוּץ), Tob.11:3 (before ἔμπροσθεν), 1Ma.16:21 * ;]
1. to run forward.
2. to run on, run in advance: Jhn.20:4; before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, Luk.19:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.
They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.
